modes.readOnly.label: Plan / read only
modes.readOnly.hint: Reads, searches and plans only. Nothing is written, only safe read-only commands run, and a plan ends in an approval you can answer.
modes.ask.label: Ask
modes.ask.hint: Asks before every edit and every command.
modes.edit.label: Edit automatically
modes.edit.hint: Edits files in your repositories without asking and runs safe read-only commands; asks before any other command.
modes.automatic.label: Automatic
modes.automatic.hint: Works without asking: edits and runs commands (tests, lint, git status and diff, scratch files in /tmp) inside the run's folders. Refuses what it cannot check in advance.
modes.bypass.label: Bypass
modes.bypass.hint: No prompts and no folder boundary. Recognisable git writes, secrets, the IDE's own files and your startup files stay blocked.
modes.picker.label: Permission mode
modes.picker.roleReadOnly: This role only reads, so Plan is preselected.
modes.autoLead: Lead: {model}, effort {effort}. It works in the mode you pick below.
modes.header.bypassTip: Bypass: no prompts, no folder boundary. Recognisable git writes, secrets and your startup files stay blocked.
modes.switch.partial: The IDE already enforces {mode}; the agent's own mode follows at the next start.
modes.switch.runningNote: Programs the agent already started keep running.
modes.err.modeNotSupported: This provider cannot run in that mode.
modes.err.modeDisabled: Automatic and Bypass are switched off in this build.
modes.err.writeLease: This repository already has as many runs changing it as are allowed. Wait for one to finish, pick Ask, or change the limits under Settings > Roles > Runs at the same time.
modes.err.noSlot: The limit of runs at the same time is reached. Wait for one to finish, or raise it under Settings > Roles > Runs at the same time.
modes.err.modeBusy: A mode change is already in progress.
modes.err.modeNotApplied: The agent did not take the new mode.
modes.err.invalidMode: Bypass cannot be chosen when leaving plan mode.
modes.err.modeChanged: The rules changed while this was waiting, so the request was withdrawn.
modes.err.optionNotOffered: That answer is not available for this request.
modes.bypass.title: Switch on Bypass?
modes.bypass.lead: In Bypass the agent works without asking and without the boundary of the run's folders.
modes.bypass.off.boundary: The folder boundary: the agent can read and write anywhere your user account can.
modes.bypass.off.static: The static check of commands: commands the IDE cannot analyse in advance will run, and scripts and programs the agent starts are not fully checked.
modes.bypass.off.network: Network access is not asked about.
modes.bypass.off.mcpServers: MCP servers you enabled run as you and are not restricted: {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} of {names} that change things run without asking.
modes.bypass.keeps.git: Recognisable git writes: commit, push, stage-all and every other git write the IDE can spot (committing is your job in the IDE). A script or dynamic command that reaches git by a route the IDE cannot see is not guaranteed to be stopped.
modes.bypass.keeps.gitTricks: env, alias, PATH and inline tricks that reach git.
modes.bypass.keeps.protectedPaths: Writes to .git and other protected paths.
modes.bypass.keeps.persistence: Your startup files and tool settings: shell profiles, launch agents, npm and Claude configuration.
modes.bypass.keeps.secrets: Reading known secret locations, also with cat and similar commands. Other places that hold secrets are not guaranteed to be covered.
modes.bypass.keeps.ideState: The IDE's own state and the MCP configuration, for the agent's own tools; an enabled MCP server can still reach them.
modes.bypass.keeps.procEnv: Commands that print other processes' environments.
modes.bypass.keeps.catastrophic: Commands that wipe the system or your whole home folder: rm, shred, dd, mkfs and similar on /, your home folder or any folder above a run's repositories.
modes.bypass.footnote: Rewind snapshots only the run's repositories. Changes anywhere else cannot be undone. Programs the agent has already started are not stopped when you leave Bypass.
modes.sessionAllow.exec: Always in this session: allows {scope} commands with any arguments inside this run's folders, except options that run other programs. Never saved to disk.
modes.sessionAllow.net: Always in this session: allows requests to {scope}. Never saved to disk.
modes.sessionAllow.mcp: Always in this session: allows {scope}. Never saved to disk.
modes.sessionAllow.write: Always in this session: allows file edits inside this run's folders. Files that run code (package.json, CI, hooks), .git, .env and lockfiles still ask or stay blocked. Never saved to disk.
modes.perm.onceOnly: This kind of call (a script, a shell construct, a file that runs code) can only be allowed once.
modes.resolved.allowSession: Allowed always in this session by you
modes.resolved.withdrawn: Withdrawn: the rules changed while this was waiting
modes.plan.title: A plan is ready
modes.plan.noText: The plan text is not available. You can still approve, or ask for changes.
modes.plan.truncated: The plan was cut at 64 KiB.
modes.plan.unattendedNote: Automatic works without asking: after you approve, the agent will not ask again.
modes.plan.placeholder: Describe what the plan should do differently
modes.banner.resumeDowngrade: This run was in Bypass. Bypass is never carried over, so it continues in Automatic.
modes.banner.roleChanged: This run's role file changed or is no longer trusted, so it continues in {mode}.
modes.banner.providerLimit: Automatic and Bypass are switched off in this build; the run continues in Ask.
modes.exposure.line: In this mode, {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} of {names} that change things run without asking.
modes.exposure.secretEnv: {names} keep a secret in their environment; in this mode a script an agent runs can read it.
stops.title: A stop you can lift
stops.ask.cliPrompt: Run a command the Claude CLI flagged: “{what}”
stops.why.secretFile: An agent normally never reads secret files. If you allow it, the content goes to the model provider and may land in logs and transcripts.
stops.why.secretEdit: An agent normally never changes env files, they hold secrets. If you allow it, the new content goes to the model provider and may land in logs and transcripts.
stops.why.cliPrompt: The Claude CLI's own safety check flagged this command and a run without prompts cannot answer it. Every other rule of the IDE has already allowed the command.
stops.denyTip: The agent is told that this stays stopped and has to carry on without it (Esc).
stops.err.answerOnComputer: This stop can only be lifted on your computer. Open the IDE there; you can still refuse it here.
stops.err.confirmationRequired: Allowing every secret file of this run needs the second confirmation.
stops.err.rulesMoved: The rules changed while this was waiting, so nothing was allowed. The agent will ask again if it still needs it.
stops.err.notOnServer: A stop is not lifted for a run on a server yet.
stops.done.read.run: You allowed reading secret files in this run
stops.done.edit.run: You allowed changing secret files in this run
stops.done.cli.once: You allowed a command the Claude CLI flagged once: “{what}”
stops.done.cli.run: You allowed the Claude CLI prompt “{what}” in this run
stops.summary.label: Stops you lifted
stops.run.secretFile: Allow all secret files in this run
stops.run.secretEdit: Allow editing all secret files in this run
stops.run.cliPrompt: Allow this exact prompt in this run
stops.reach.secretFile: “Allow once” covers only this file, this one time. The run-wide choice covers every secret-looking file inside this run's folders (nothing under .git, .claude, .ssh or the IDE's data), for the lead agent and its helpers, until the run ends.
stops.reach.secretEdit: “Allow once” covers only this file, this one time. The run-wide choice covers editing every secret-looking env file inside this run's folders (nothing under .git, .claude, .ssh or the IDE's data), for the lead agent and its helpers, until the run ends.
stops.confirm.q.secretFile: Allow reading every secret-looking file in this run's folders until the run ends? Their content goes to the model provider and may be written to logs and transcripts.
stops.confirm.q.secretEdit: Allow changing every secret-looking env file in this run's folders until the run ends? The new content goes to the model provider and may be written to logs and transcripts.
stops.done.cli.used: Allowed the Claude CLI prompt “{what}” under the run-wide permission
